baseHeader.methodology: Source-linked original summaries and reference-guided educational reconstructions. Models and motion are unvalidated; artist titles do not independently verify taxonomy. Navigation groups are not a universal kingdom system. Microbial behavior depends on strain and conditions. Expansion entries are individually referenced authored morphology studies; legacy Protista/Monera reporting categories do not replace modern domains. Actual screenshots, software checks and draft status are distinct from independent scientific validation.

visual.fidelity: Original distinct reference reconstruction; fine anatomy, material optics and biological timing unmeasured
visual.description: Original short anterior shield, short ocular stalks, larger right granular chela and smaller left chela replace an undifferentiated draft. Four principal walking limbs are distinct from reduced P4/P5 shell-support cues. A partial soft curled pleon is enclosed by an open helicospiral shelter of undetermined gastropod taxon; that shell is not counted as another species. Selected cream/orange mottled cuticle with seated granule/spinule cues and greenish eye ends follows the authentic reference qualitatively. The original numeric shell has continuous whorls, a lip, inner wall and subdued worn pigment. No source photo pixels or measured material calibration are used.
visual.scale: normalized display; not a specimen measurement

finalOctober24.shape: Two visible walking pairs and a larger right chela are cues; shell coiling/aperture and continuous concealed abdomen/limb attachment remain unrealistic.
finalOctober24.surface: Borrowed shell and body are smooth and pale; shell ornament, claw granules and bristles absent.
finalOctober24.movement: Top views show local finger movement only; no walking, shell retraction or antenna contact.
